what.text: This page follows refugees from Ukraine living in Portugal, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 59343 Ukrainian refugees in Portugal, 1.1% of all refugees from Ukraine.
The largest numbers of Ukrainian refugees live in Germany, Poland, Czechia and the United Kingdom.

why.text: UCDP records an interstate armed conflict between Russia and Ukraine from 2022 to 2025, at war level in every year.
Before that, it records armed conflict over Novorossiya territory in Ukraine from 2014 to 2022, with the DPR, the LPR and the United Armed Forces of Novorossiya.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2014 at 16 refugees.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2022 to 2025, and the figure is at its highest at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Portugal.
These are year-end totals for Portugal only, reported to UNHCR.
